name: They Watch
source:
The mission is simple: observe and report. No matter how strange or tempting it gets – do not make contact. The anomalies are always watching.

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/they-watch]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
任务很简单：观察和报告。无论它变得多么奇怪或诱人——都不要接触。异常现象始终在注视着。

[来自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/they-watch]Itch.io[/url]]
